scope: Bundled component with frozen client and synthetic fetch; no product API/DB navigation

groups.name: labels, keyboard number input, no default confirmations, hashes and responsive layout
explicit adoption preserves source and refreshes actual version data
conflict refresh displays changed target dose/hash and requires every confirmation again
server-error keeps exact retry operation and never duplicates acceptance
lost-response keeps exact retry operation and never duplicates acceptance
revoked hides source/targets and permits no second adoption
refresh-revoked hides source/targets and permits no second adoption
already adopted version never silently readopts
foreign preview never renders protected original data
scope lifetime abort clears prior data immediately
explicit blocked policy suppresses targets and changing it clears confirmations
